description: This file contains unit tests for the UpdateFilter class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing methods related to superuser authentication and role checking.

classes.name: UpdateFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the UpdateFilter’s authentication and role validation methods.

methods.name: authenticateAsSuperUser_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenInvalidCredentials
methods.description: Tests that the authenticateAsSuperUser method returns false with invalid username and password.

methods.name: authenticateAsSuperUser_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenUserIsNotSuperuser
methods.description: Checks that authenticateAsSuperUser returns false when user is not a superuser.

methods.name: authenticateAsSuperUser_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenUserIsSuperuser
methods.description: Checks that authenticateAsSuperUser returns true for known superuser credentials.

methods.name: isSuperUser_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenUserHasSuperuserRole
methods.description: Verifies that isSuperUser returns true when user ID corresponds to a superuser.

methods.name: isSuperUser_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenUserDoesNotHaveTheSuperUserRole
methods.description: Verifies that isSuperUser returns false when user ID does not correspond to a superuser.
